annotatedSteps.description: Assume rationality and express √3 in terms of a and b
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
Let 5 − 2√3 be rational. Then 5 − 2√3 = a/b, where a and b are integers and b ≠ 0.
⇒ 2√3 = 5 − a/b = (5b − a)/b
⇒ √3 = (5b − a)/(2b)
Since a and b are integers, (5b − a)/(2b) is rational, but √3 is irrational. This is a contradiction.
